text_block_list.text:
During our training meeting, Biwa
Hayahide gives
out a sudden
exclamation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What?! Objection! The defendant's
explanation
is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem. Excuse me. Please continue as
you were.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Um... You know that courtroom TV
drama
everyone's been talking about? It
was about
that...
choice_data_list: それで何の夢を見ていたんだ？
それで何の夢を見ていたの？
choice_data_list_en: So, what were you dreaming about?
So, what kind of dream were you having?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't ask me any more. I'm
already
embarrassed about that little
outburst...

However, another "Objection!" rings out
ten
minutes later. It seems like Biwa
Hayahide's not
getting enough sleep.
